one_line: A questionnaire-based survey study assessing the sustainability of ISO 50001 Energy Management System implementation across 28 Indonesian pilot-company industries (predominantly textile/garment, plus glass/ceramic, pulp & paper, food & beverage, and chemical), treating all sectors uniformly rather than studying any continuous-flow production process.
